# Shared-wallet fixtures

`shared-wallet-v3.json` is generated by
`scripts/shared-wallet-conformance.py --generate` using LOC's vendored protobufs
and signed-settlement fixture builders. Initial generation used LOC `fe55795`
plus its shared-wallet review fixes, with Modules `f39740c` present.

All keys are deterministic public test keys: caller scalar 1, payer bytes
`02` repeated 32 times, and LOC's settlement fixture key (`01` repeated).
Authorization and settlement timestamps are intentionally frozen. These are
cryptographic interoperability vectors, not usable production grants or a
claim that an expired fixture will pass broker admission today.

The Go test covers two account labels across ABR, live, accepted refill and
refused successor recovery. It checks authorization/proof wire bytes, encrypted
journal recovery, retained predecessor/successor identity and exact signed
settlement preservation. Job evidence includes an account version above 2^53.
The Python gate feeds the Go test's recovered output into LOC's production
verification functions and checks rejection against another account.

Database lifecycle, ambiguous dispatch, retry and no-duplicate issuance are
covered by the existing paid-engine integration tests. LOC's real-stack gate
separately exercises current grants with real payer, receiver and broker
processes; production GPU/TLS acceptance remains a deployment check.
